newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong money markets closed for holiday.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong money markets closed for holiday.

text.p: Hong Kong money markets are closed on Monday for a public holiday. Trade will resume on Tuesday.
On Friday, interbank rates were slightly firmer with overight cash at 5-5/16 9/32 percent at midday and three-month money at 5-1/2 15/32 percent.

Government paper yields were down a hair with the seven-year Exchange Fund note yielding 7.48 percent, the five-year yielding 7.11 percent, the three-year yielding 6.53 percent, and the one-week bill yielding 4.90 percent.
